text: Ethics in AI is becoming an important topic as artificial intelligence plays a larger role in our daily lives. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can make unfair decisions if they are trained on unbalanced data. Fairness means that AI should treat all people equally, regardless of their background. Privacy is also a serious issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. Transparency helps people understand how AI makes decisions, which builds trust. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create rules that protect users. If we ignore these ethical questions, AI could cause more harm than good.
